tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1994 年发布
description: 美能达于1994年推出的取景器相机。配备28 mm f/5,6.。快门速度1/125 s.。使用Automatic loading and advance, manually activated motor rewind.。感光度DX coded films ISO 100–400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Active infrared autofocus from 1,2 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus from 1,2 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in auto flash with anti-red eye lamp. Forced flash and flash off modes. Range: 1,5–2,7 m. Flash ready LED signal.
specs.感光度: DX coded films ISO 100–400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.胶片/画幅: Automatic loading and advance, manually activated motor rewind.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta F 20R is a 1994 compact camera, basically a fixed focus version of the AF 101R.
